'''November 2001 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Galactic Quest, Buford, Georgia on 24 November 2001. [[Will Gilchrist]] won it. It is known from Will Gilchrist's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3117">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-24-buford-georgia-11-24-01d3117/ buford-georgia-11-24-01], DeckTech (will "Magmaniac" gilchrist, 24 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-24-buford-georgia-11-24-01d3117/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Galactic Quest, Buford, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Will Gilchrist]]
